name: Execute a SQL query
query:
WITH new_user AS (
  INSERT INTO users (
    name,
    email,
    password_hash,
    sector_id,
    active,
    is_master
  )
  VALUES (
    '{{ String(($("Webhook").item.json.body.name || "")).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String(($("Webhook").item.json.body.email || "")).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    crypt(
      '{{ String(($("Webhook").item.json.body.passwordHash || $("Webhook").item.json.body.password || "")).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
      gen_salt('bf', 10)
    ),
    NULLIF('{{ $("Webhook").item.json.body.sectorId || "" }}', '')::uuid,
    {{ $("Webhook").item.json.body.active === false || $("Webhook").item.json.body.active === 'false' ? 'FALSE' : 'TRUE' }},
    {{ $("Webhook").item.json.body.isMaster === true || $("Webhook").item.json.body.isMaster === 'true' ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE' }}
  )
  RETURNING id, name, email, sector_id, active, is_master, created_at, updated_at
),
inserted_permissions AS (
  INSERT INTO user_permissions (user_id, permission_id)
  SELECT DISTINCT
    new_user.id,
    p.id
  FROM new_user
  CROSS JOIN permissions p
  WHERE p.code <> 'gerenciar_tags'
    AND p.code IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT jsonb_array_elements_text(
        '{{ JSON.stringify($("Webhook").item.json.body.permissions || []) }}'::jsonb
      )
    )
  ON CONFLICT (user_id, permission_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING permission_id
)
SELECT
  u.id,
  u.name,
  u.email,
  u.sector_id AS "sectorId",
  s.name AS "sectorName",
  u.active,
  u.is_master AS "isMaster",
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT json_agg(p.code ORDER BY p.code)
      FROM inserted_permissions ip
      JOIN permissions p ON p.id = ip.permission_id
      WHERE p.code <> 'gerenciar_tags'
    ),
    '[]'::json
  ) AS permissions,
  u.created_at AS "createdAt",
  u.updated_at AS "updatedAt"
FROM new_user u
LEFT JOIN sectors s ON s.id = u.sector_id;
